name: taste-tuner
description: Structured tools for driving TasteTuner. Every tool talks to the running app (or its saved-response replay server) over its own HTTP API, so budgets, credentials, parsing and re-ranking are the production path — not a second implementation.

base_url.note: Point this at a live instance, or at a saved-response replay server to consume cached data without issuing API calls.

tools.name: resolve_seed
tools.summary: Resolve a film title to real entities.
tools.description: Resolves a title through the app's search step. When several real entities match, the result is ambiguous and the caller must pick one of the returned candidates before asking for candidates.

entity_type.description: Which category to search in. Output stays movies either way.

tools.name: get_candidates
tools.summary: Fetch candidate films for a confirmed seed entity.
tools.description: Issues the recommendation call for one confirmed entity id. The service returns the candidates, their affinity/popularity values and the explainability attribution.

limit.description: How many candidates to request (the event API path takes at most 5 here).

tools.name: reorder_candidates
tools.summary: Re-rank an already fetched candidate set locally.
tools.description: Applies hard constraints and the three weights to a frozen candidate set. No network call is made; the same production ranker the UI uses is reused.

seed_tags.description: Tags of the confirmed seed, used for tag similarity.
